**Issue #1845 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1845: Patch: hidden Nerfs and trade offers
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Phase 0 of the Stinkyscape set: a mechanic merged on `main` without the set. No card reaches it until fullsend 1 ships the set; its Stinkyscape cards are built later, in S18.

## The rule

A Nerf hidden from the card's owner until it is played, never touching its cost (Stinkyscape #123 Gokugains: three Nerfs, thirty on its Radiant face, on a random Unit in the opponent's hand), through `view_for`, the AI's redaction and `determinize`; and a trade offer at the opponent's start of turn: you give a card from your hand, they Discover one of theirs to give you (#77 Yuma).

## Done when

- The rule is an engine primitive (`crates/engine`), proved on fixture scripts (`crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/`, the `testkit`'s `scenario()`), its edges included. No Stinkyscape card is needed or added: the cards come later, behind the set's gate.
- Its §6 row (and §3, §4 or §10 where it touches them), and ruling notes from this issue's block, R(N×1000) up, each named after its proving test (CLAUDE.md rule 3); `cargo jackioh spec index` and `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- A new event has its `ANIMATIONS` and `SOUND_CUES` rows; a new prompt or action is answered by `crates/ai`, the random policy and the timeout, and `legalActions`, the reducer's refusal and the view agree. Hidden cards never change the AI's decision (`crates/ai`'s rule).
- The client's piece, where the mechanic has one, renders `viewFor` alone (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
- New state is optional and skipped when absent, so no shipped game changes: no golden trace moves and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main` names no card that plays differently (plan D3).
- Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9) and the pure crates stay pure (rule 4).
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`, and the web's typecheck and tests where the client changed.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST3, ST5); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

Part of #1836.
```

````markdown
# Draft plan #1845 (planner notes, in progress)

## Read so far
- docs/stinkyscape-set.md on commit cbe1ce05c (ST3 M11, ST5 D3/D5/D7). Cards: #123 Gokugains (Cry: a random Unit in
  opponent's hand nerfed 3 times secretly, 30 Radiant; nerfs avoid cost; owner doesn't see until played), #77 Yuma
  (Cry: trade offer at opponent's start of turn: you give any card in hand, they Discover one of theirs to give you).
- spec §6.3 Nerf row (06-keywords.md:149), Steal row (give from hand, C #9), Discover row; R386, R440, R177, R311.
- tune.rs: tune_once (pub), menu_of (cost_row first), degrade/upgrade, reached_cards (R440 whole-pile picks: NOT for us).
- card_scope.rs: cards_in_card_scope(ctx, scope, Some(&CardScopeOptions{whole_hidden_piles:None, aim:Some(Harm)})) → matching only.
- delay.rs: delay(DelayArgs{at, step, hook, turns:Some(1), label}) can carry an engine hook; run_engine_delayed returns false
  for unknown hooks → turn.rs run_resume_for → prompts::run_resume → hook_for → work::script_step_for.
- work.rs:640 script_step_for has precedent CHAOS_ETERNAL_HOOK (engine-owned step whatever the def) → add TRADE_OFFER_HOOK branch.
- prompts.rs: open_prompt(OpenPromptArgs{player, kind, owner,...}); answer path generic (answer_owned only for listed hooks).
- choose.rs choose_from_hand (PromptKind::Hand option shape), offer_instances (Discover, DISCOVER_OPTIONS=3 config.rs:929).
- ownership.rs change_owner (pub, stolen event), take_into_hand; draw::add_to_hand (burn when full); zones::remove_from_any_zone.
- play_steps.rs gifted_hook_step: first-entry block (replace_played_card, feng_shui, gifted_program, garden) — both plays
  and casts pass it (cast_through_pipeline starts at GiftedHook). Land hidden nerfs after garden_step there.
- state.rs CardInstance: one full literal in new_instance (state.rs:~1985). Copies copy explicit fields (summon.rs 446,
  add_to_hand.rs 146) so a new field is not copied; reset_instance (zones.rs:1136) leaves unknown fields alone.
- spec §10.1 lists CardInstance fields (10-engine-guide.md ~line 88).

## Design
- Hidden Nerf: `CardInstance.hidden_nerfs: Option<i32>` (skip when None). Verb `degrade_secretly(TuneArgs)` (named card or
  scope + random among MATCHING cards), adds `times`; no event, no view. Lands in gifted_hook_step first entry via
  `hidden_nerfs::land_hidden_nerfs(sink, id, player)`: take count, set None, N × tune.rs `degrade_without_cost`.
  Determinize / conceal_from clear it (AI blind).
- Trade offer: `trade_offer()` = delay(at {Start, Enemy}, hook TRADE_OFFER_HOOK "@tradeOffer", step "offer", turns 1, label).
  Steps (subsystems/trade_offer.rs): offer → Hand prompt to offerer (own hand); give → Discover prompt (≤3 random of
  taker's hand) to taker, owner offerer, data given; take → swap (change_owner both, remove both, add_to_hand both).
  Nothing if either hand empty. Reuses PromptKind::Hand / Discover → AI/random/timeout/legalActions generic (verify).
- Rulings R1845000.. (hidden nerf; its edges; trade offer; the swap).
````

</details>
